k1797:
A private house at Manëz e Vjetër, in the older part of the village north of Durrës.

The house has three storeys of roughly 120 m² each and stands on a plot of 300 m².

The structure is regular and the floors are laid out sensibly, which leaves room to organise the interior as the buyer wants rather than around what is already there.

The area is quiet and residential, the sort of place people move to for space rather than for the coast. It works as a family house, and the size makes it a reasonable long-term hold.
k1798: 1+1 apartment on the main road, Plazh, Durrës
k1799: A 66 m² one-bedroom flat on the fifth floor beside the main road at Plazh; the building has no lift.
k1800:
A 1+1 apartment at Plazh, standing on the main road opposite Vila Doka.

The flat measures 66 m²: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, on the fifth floor. There is no lift in the building, and at this level that is the trade-off worth weighing before viewing.

What the position gives in return is access. The main road runs past the door, so transport, shops and the beach are all reached without a detour, and tenants find the address easily.

This part of Plazh has been developing steadily, and flats here let through the season as well as year round.
k1801: Two 1+1 apartments with a 50 m² veranda, Shkëmbi i Kavajës
k1802: Two one-bedroom flats on the first floor at Shkëmbi i Kavajës, 85 m² on the certificate, with a shared veranda of 50 m².
k1803:
Two 1+1 apartments at Shkëmbi i Kavajës, sold together, on the first floor.

The certificate records 85 m², and a veranda of a further 50 m² belongs with them — an outdoor area half the size of the flats themselves, which on this coast is where the summer is actually lived.

Two separate flats in one purchase gives room to manoeuvre: live in one and let the other, put family in both, or run them as two short-term lets side by side.

Shkëmbi i Kavajës is among the most established holiday areas near Durrës, with the sea and the main services both a short walk off.
k1805: A 61 m² one-bedroom flat on the second floor at Golem, near the sea and the resorts; the seller will take a car worth up to €20,000 in part exchange.
k1806:
A 1+1 apartment at Golem, in one of the busiest tourist parts of the Albanian coast.

The flat measures 61 m² in total: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, on the second residential floor.

One term of the sale is unusual and worth knowing about: the seller will accept a car worth up to €20,000 as part of the payment. That can suit a buyer with a vehicle to dispose of, though it is worth having the car valued independently before relying on it.

The sea and the larger resorts are close by, and flats of this size let well through the season.
k1807: 1+1 apartment with a veranda, Plazh Hekurudha
k1808: A one-bedroom flat at Plazh Hekurudha, 52 m² on the certificate and 66 m² with the veranda, ready to live in.
k1809:
A 1+1 apartment in the Hekurudha part of Plazh, a few minutes on foot from the sea.

The certificate records 52 m²; counted with the veranda the flat comes to 66 m². Inside there is a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, on the second floor of a building with a lift.

The veranda is the part that changes how the flat is used. On this coast the outdoor space is where the summer actually happens, and here it is generous rather than token.

The flat is ready to live in, the plan is practical and the rooms hold daylight through the day.
k1810: Second and third floors of a house on the main road, Shkozet
k1811: Two floors of a private house at Shkozet, 250 m² each and laid out as 2+1, sold together on a 600 m² plot.
k1812:
The second and third floors of a three-storey private house at Shkozet, on the main road.

Each floor covers 250 m² and is laid out as a 2+1, so the two together come to 500 m² of living space. The plot the house stands on is 600 m². Only these two floors are for sale; the ground floor is not part of the offer.

Two full floors under one roof suit two households, or one that wants a clear separation between generations. The rooms are unusually large for this kind of property and daylight reaches them through the day.

The position gives quick access to the motorway, the centre of Durrës and the main services.
k1813: Furnished 1+1 apartment at Pishat e Buta, Golem
k1814: An 82 m² one-bedroom flat on the sixth floor of a new building at Pishat e Buta, sold fully furnished.
k1815:
A 1+1 apartment at Pishat e Buta in Golem, the pine-backed part of this coast.

The flat measures 82.2 m², which is well above the usual for a one-bedroom layout: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, on the sixth floor of a new building with a lift.

It is sold fully furnished, and the furniture has been looked after rather than left to wear out — so the flat can be used or let from the day it changes hands.

The mortgage paperwork is in order. The sea and the main services are close, and this is one of the areas where short-term letting holds up well.
k1817: An 80 m² one-bedroom flat at Golem with room to add a second bedroom; on the fourth floor, no lift.
k1818:
A 1+1 apartment at Golem with 80 m² of floor area — enough that a second bedroom can be taken out of it without the rooms becoming cramped.

As it stands there is a living room, a kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom. The conversion to a 2+1 is what the extra area is really for, and it is the reason to look at this one rather than a smaller flat at a similar price.

It is on the fourth floor and the building has no lift, which is the plain drawback.

Golem keeps developing, and the sea and the main services are both close. The flat suits a family as much as an investor willing to do the work first.
k1819: 1+1 apartment in a gated complex with a pool, Golem
k1820: A 75 m² one-bedroom flat a hundred metres from the sea, in a managed complex with a pool, parking and round-the-clock security.
k1821:
A 1+1 apartment at Golem, a hundred metres from the sea, inside a managed residential complex.

The flat measures 75 m² gross and 65 m² net: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, on the third residential floor. It has been fully done up and is ready to live in.

What sets it apart is the complex around it rather than the flat itself. There is a pool, parking for residents, a guard on the entrance and access limited to people who live there. For a flat that will stand empty part of the year, that matters.

The seller is open to discussing the price.
k1822: Renovated 1+1 apartment at street level, Vollga, Durrës
k1823: A 75 m² one-bedroom flat at Vollga, fully rebuilt including the wiring and plumbing, at ground level.
k1824:
A 1+1 apartment at Vollga, the seafront promenade quarter and one of the more desirable addresses in Durrës.

The flat measures 75 m² gross and 70.02 m² net: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom.

It has been fully renovated, and not only on the surface — the electrical and plumbing installations are new, which is the expensive half of a refurbishment and the half that usually gets skipped.

The flat sits at ground level. That makes it easy to walk into, and on a promenade address it also opens the possibility of a use other than living, depending on what the building permits.
k1825: 65 m² commercial unit at Plazh Iliria, Durrës
k1826: A 65 m² commercial space at Plazh Iliria, in a busy area with both residents and holidaymakers passing through.
k1827:
A commercial unit of 65 m² at Plazh Iliria, one of the more frequented parts of the Durrës beach area.

The space is open and adaptable, which is what makes it worth considering: a small market, a boutique, a pharmacy, an office, a salon or a clinic would all fit without structural work.

The footfall here comes from two directions at once — people who live in the surrounding blocks year round, and holidaymakers through the season. A business that depends on passing trade has both to work with.

Access is straightforward and the position is close to both the residential streets and the tourist strip.
k1829: A 35 m² studio in the Iliria part of Plazh, compactly laid out and close to the sea.
k1830:
A studio in the Iliria part of Plazh, one of the more popular pockets near the Durrës shore.

The flat measures 35 m² gross and 28 m² net, arranged as a single functional space.

At this size the plan is everything, and here it has been handled sensibly: the living area, the kitchen corner and the sleeping space work together rather than crowding one another.

The sea and the ordinary services are both within reach on foot. A studio here suits a first purchase, a summer base or something bought to let by the week.
k1831: Furnished studio with a sea view, Shkëmbi i Kavajës
k1832: A 38 m² studio at Shkëmbi i Kavajës with a view of the sea, fully furnished and on the first floor.
k1833:
A studio at Shkëmbi i Kavajës, on the first residential floor, with the sea in view.

The net area is 38 m²; counted with the shared parts of the building the certificate shows 43 m². The space is arranged as one functional room and comes fully furnished.

A sea view from a flat this size is unusual — it is normally the larger apartments that face the water, and it is what lifts this one above the other studios on the same stretch.

Shkëmbi i Kavajës is among the most sought-after parts of the coast, and small furnished flats here let well through the season. The seller will discuss the price.
k1834: House for full renovation on a 140 m² plot, Spitallë
k1835: A 67 m² house on a 140 m² plot at Spitallë, needing complete reconstruction.
k1836:
A private house at Spitallë, in a quiet part of the area north of Durrës.

The building covers 67 m² and stands on a plot of 140 m², which leaves usable ground around it.

This one needs to be said plainly: the house requires a complete reconstruction. It is not a property to move into — it is a shell to rework, and the budget for that work sits on top of the purchase price.

For a buyer who wanted to shape a house from scratch without buying bare land, that is the appeal: the plot, the footprint and the access are already there, and what goes inside is an open question.
k1837: 1+1 apartment close to the sea, Plazh, Durrës
k1838: A 57 m² one-bedroom flat at Plazh with the paperwork in order, suited to living in or letting by the season.
k1839:
A 1+1 apartment at Plazh, in one of the most sought-after parts of the Durrës coast.

The flat measures 57 m²: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, in a straightforward and workable arrangement.

The mortgage paperwork is in order, which shortens the slowest part of a purchase here.

The sea is close and the surrounding services are within walking distance. The flat covers all three of the usual cases on this coast — living in year round, using it in summer, or letting it by the week. The seller is open to discussing the price.
k1840: Large top-floor loft at Ish Rajoni, Durrës
k1841: A loft at Ish Rajoni with 111.6 m² of net floor area and 250 m² in total, on the eighth floor; sold without mortgage financing.
k1842:
A loft at Ish Rajoni in Durrës, on the eighth floor of a building with a lift.

The net floor area is 111.6 m², and the space counts 250 m² in total. That gap is what a loft is: the usable floor is smaller than the volume, and how much of the rest can be brought into use depends on what the buyer is willing to build.

The scale is the attraction. There is room here to lay the interior out from scratch, which a conventional flat of the same price would not allow.

One condition matters: the property is sold without the possibility of mortgage financing, so the purchase has to be funded outright. That is worth settling before anything else.
k1843: Studio laid out as a 1+1, Shkëmbi i Kavajës
k1844: A 50 m² studio partitioned into a separate bedroom and living room, on the third floor of a new building with a lift.
